test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

__Shirley have had all her children with__ the help of a fertility drug.

options.text: Shirley had all her children through
Shirley have had all her children by
Shirley has had all her children with

solution:
The correct answer is **Shirley has had all her children with**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence is **Shirley had had all her children with.**
 
• In English grammar, **"had had"** is used in the past perfect tense. When describing events or actions that happened before another event or action in the past, the past perfect tense is employed.
 
• Thus the correct sentence would be Shirley has had all her children with.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Have had is the verb's present perfect tense equivalent.
 
 
• ‘Have you had your breakfast?’
 
 
 
• Had had (had + past participle form of having) is the past perfect form of the verb to have.
 
 
• She felt marvellous after she had had a good night’s sleep.
